```{r script-info, include=FALSE}
# This script was used to create the following figures:
# Figure 4a: Jaccard similarity of the 242 robust NMF programs, ordered by metaprogram (MP)
# Figure 4b: UMAPs of the nine MP scores (UCell)
# Figure 4c: gene overlap of the MPs with the 3CA malignant metaprograms
# Figure 4d: Hallmark and GO BP enrichment of the MPs
# Figure 4e: patient-level MP scores in non-malignant melanocytes, primary tumors and metastases
# Figure 4f, g: MP8 and MP6 in primary tumors with disomy 3 or monosomy 3
# Supplementary Figure 7a: gene-set overlap between the nine MPs
# Supplementary Figure 7b: effect sizes of the patient-level comparisons
# Supplementary Figure 7c: highest-scoring MP before and on tebentafusp
# Supplementary Figure 7d: per-cell MP scores before and on tebentafusp
# Supplementary Table 4: top 50 genes of each MP
# (Figure 4h and Supplementary Figure 7e are drug-response assays, not produced here.)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

source("colors_2026b.R")

obj_file <- "../new_data_2026b/Objects/MelanocyteMelanoma/MelanomaMelanocyteSubset_Revision.qs2"
U  <- "../Outputs/GeneNMF_2026b/highK_melanocytes"    # NMF units: 500 cells per sample
J  <- "../Outputs/GeneNMF_2026b/highK_centered"       # NMF programs, MP genes, enrichment
S  <- file.path(J, "17k")                             # UCell scores of all melanocytic cells
TB <- "../Outputs/GeneNMF_2026b/17l_mp_tebe_xenium"   # UCell scores of the tebentafusp tumour cells
umap_file <- "../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b/atlas_umap.csv.gz"   # atlas UMAP (CytoTRACE2.Rmd)

qread <- function(f) qs2::qs_read(f, nthreads = 1); qsave <- function(x, f) qs2::qs_save(x, f, nthreads = 1)

# NMF and Gavish et al. 2023 parameters (Methods)
MIN_CELLS <- 100; N_SUB <- 500; KS <- c(8, 10, 12); NTOP <- 50
INTRA_MIN <- 35; INTER_MIN <- 10; REDUND <- 10; CLUST_MIN <- 10; MIN_GROUP <- 5; MIN_SAMPLE_FRAC <- 0.10
MP_NAMES <- c(MP1 = "Immediate-early stress response / AP-1", MP2 = "Developmental regulation",
              MP3 = "Respiratory electron transport / OXPHOS", MP4 = "Mitotic cell cycle (G2/M)", MP5 = "OXPHOS / MYC targets",
              MP6 = "Interferon response / antigen presentation", MP7 = "DNA replication (G1/S)",
              MP8 = "Guidance / cell adhesion", MP9 = "Neural-associated signalling")
mps <- names(MP_NAMES); lab <- setNames(paste(mps, MP_NAMES), mps)
MP_COLS <- setNames(c("#762A83", "#1B7837", "#C51B7D", "#B8E186", "#8073AC", "#4D9221", "#F1B6DA", "#80CDC1", "#D6606D"), mps)
nm_rgx <- "^RP[SL][0-9]|^RPLP|^MT-|^MRP[SL][0-9]"   # ribosomal and mitochondrial genes are never NMF features

save_gg <- function(p, id, w, h) {
```

## Overview

```{r nmf}
# NMF units: every orig.ident with >= 100 melanoma cells or healthy melanocytes, 500 cells drawn per unit
units_file <- file.path(U, "per_sample_cell_counts.csv"); sl_file <- file.path(U, "sample_list.qs2")
nmf_file <- file.path(J, "17j_nmf_programs.qs2")
if (!file.exists(nmf_file) && !file.exists(sl_file)) {
  o <- qread(obj_file); md <- o@meta.data; md$cell <- rownames(md)
  md$group <- case_when(md$majority_celltype == "Melanoma cells" ~ "malignant", md$majority_celltype == "Melanocytes" ~ "healthy")
  keep <- md$cell[!is.na(md$group)]
  units <- md[keep, ] |> summarise(n_cells = n(), .by = c(group, origin, orig.ident, Patient_nr)) |> mutate(used = n_cells >= MIN_CELLS)
  write.csv(units, units_file, row.names = FALSE)
  o[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(o[["RNA"]]); cnt <- SeuratObject::LayerData(o, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, keep]; rm(o)
  set.seed(42)
  sl <- lapply(setNames(nm = sort(units$orig.ident[units$used])), function(s) {
    cells <- keep[md[keep, "orig.ident"] == s]
    if (length(cells) > N_SUB) cells <- sample(cells, N_SUB)
    CreateSeuratObject(cnt[, cells], meta.data = md[cells, ], min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
  })
  qsave(sl, sl_file); rm(cnt, sl); invisible(gc())
}
units <- read.csv(units_file)
samples <- sort(units$orig.ident[units$used])

# per unit: 2,000 variable genes, scaled (centred) regressing percent.mt, negatives set to 0, NMF at k = 8, 10, 12
if (!file.exists(nmf_file)) {
  sl <- qread(sl_file)[samples]
  res <- parallel::mclapply(samples, function(s) {
    o <- NormalizeData(sl[[s]], verbose = FALSE)
    o[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(o, pattern = "^MT-")
    o <- FindVariableFeatures(o, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = nrow(o), verbose = FALSE)
    hv <- HVFInfo(o); hv <- hv[!grepl(nm_rgx, rownames(hv)), ]
    hvg <- head(rownames(hv)[order(hv$variance.standardized, decreasing = TRUE)], 2000)
    o <- ScaleData(o, features = hvg, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)
    m <- as.matrix(LayerData(o, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data"))[hvg, ]
    m[m < 0] <- 0; m <- m[rowSums(m) > 0, ]
    progs <- list()
    for (k in KS) {
      fit <- RcppML::nmf(m, k = k, seed = 123, verbose = FALSE)
      w <- fit@w; rownames(w) <- rownames(m)
      for (i in seq_len(k)) {
        wi <- sort(w[, i], decreasing = TRUE)[1:NTOP]
        progs[[sprintf("%s.k%d.%d", s, k, i)]] <- tibble(gene = names(wi), weight = unname(wi) / sum(w[, i]))
      }
    }
    list(programs = progs, hvg = hvg, n_cells = ncol(o))
  }, mc.cores = min(ncores, length(samples)), mc.preschedule = FALSE)
  names(res) <- samples
  stopifnot("an NMF worker failed" = !any(vapply(res, function(r) is.null(r) || inherits(r, "try-error"), logical(1))))
  qsave(res, nmf_file)
}
res <- qread(nmf_file)
stopifnot(setequal(names(res), samples))
```

```{r metaprograms}
# robust programs (Gavish et al. 2023): >= 35/50 genes shared with a program of another k in the same unit,
# >= 10 with a program of another unit, and no redundancy within a unit (>= 10 shared genes, best recurrence kept)
prog <- unlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "programs"), recursive = FALSE)
names(prog) <- sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", names(prog))
pg <- lapply(prog, `[[`, "gene")
pinfo <- tibble(program = names(prog), orig.ident = sub("\\.k\\d+\\.\\d+$", "", names(prog)),
                k = as.integer(sub(".*\\.k(\\d+)\\.\\d+$", "\\1", names(prog)))) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(units, orig.ident, group, Patient_nr), by = "orig.ident")
allg <- unique(unlist(pg))
inc <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = match(unlist(pg), allg), j = rep(seq_along(pg), lengths(pg)), x = 1,
                            dims = c(length(allg), length(pg)), dimnames = list(allg, names(pg)))
O <- as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(inc))
same_s <- outer(pinfo$orig.ident, pinfo$orig.ident, "=="); same_k <- outer(pinfo$k, pinfo$k, "==")
pinfo$intra_max <- apply(O * (same_s & !same_k), 1, max)
pinfo$inter_max <- apply(O * (!same_s), 1, max)
pinfo$inter_sum <- rowSums((O >= INTER_MIN) & !same_s)
cand <- pinfo$intra_max >= INTRA_MIN & pinfo$inter_max >= INTER_MIN
keep <- rep(FALSE, nrow(pinfo))
for (s in samples) {
  idx <- which(pinfo$orig.ident == s & cand)
  idx <- idx[order(-pinfo$inter_max[idx], -pinfo$inter_sum[idx])]
  kept <- integer(0)
  for (i in idx) if (!length(kept) || all(O[i, kept] < REDUND)) kept <- c(kept, i)
  keep[kept] <- TRUE
}
pinfo$robust <- keep
rob <- pinfo$program[pinfo$robust]; Or <- O[rob, rob]

# greedy clustering (Gavish et al. 2023): seed = program with most partners (>= 10 shared genes, >= 5 partners);
# add the program sharing most genes with the current MP genes while >= 10; MP genes = top 50 by recurrence
mp_genes_of <- function(members) {
  bind_rows(lapply(members, function(p) prog[[p]])) |> group_by(gene) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean_w = mean(weight), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(n), desc(mean_w)) |>
    mutate(recurrence = n / length(members)) |> head(NTOP)
}
remaining <- rob; clusters <- list()
repeat {
  if (length(remaining) < 2) break
  Orr <- Or[remaining, remaining, drop = FALSE]; diag(Orr) <- 0
  nsim <- rowSums(Orr >= CLUST_MIN)
  if (max(nsim) < MIN_GROUP) break
  members <- names(which.max(nsim)); genes <- prog[[members]]$gene
  repeat {
    cands <- setdiff(remaining, members)
    if (!length(cands)) break
    ov <- vapply(cands, function(p) length(intersect(pg[[p]], genes)), numeric(1))
    if (max(ov) < CLUST_MIN) break
    members <- c(members, cands[which.max(ov)]); genes <- mp_genes_of(members)$gene
  }
  clusters[[length(clusters) + 1]] <- members
  remaining <- setdiff(remaining, members)
}
n_samp <- function(m) n_distinct(pinfo$orig.ident[match(m, pinfo$program)])
clusters <- clusters[sapply(clusters, n_samp) >= ceiling(MIN_SAMPLE_FRAC * length(samples)) & lengths(clusters) >= 2]
clusters <- clusters[order(-sapply(clusters, n_samp))]
names(clusters) <- paste0("MP", seq_along(clusters))
stopifnot(length(clusters) == length(mps))
mpg <- lapply(clusters, mp_genes_of)
genes <- lapply(mpg, `[[`, "gene")
pinfo <- left_join(pinfo, bind_rows(lapply(mps, function(k) tibble(program = clusters[[k]], MP = k))), by = "program")
mp_file <- file.path(J, "17j_mp_genes.csv")
if (file.exists(mp_file)) { g0 <- read.csv(mp_file); stopifnot("MP genes differ from the cache" = identical(genes, split(g0$gene, g0$MP)[mps])) }
gene_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(mps, function(k) mpg[[k]] |>
  transmute(MP = k, label = MP_NAMES[[k]], rank = row_number(), gene, recurrence = round(recurrence, 3), mean_weight = signif(mean_w, 3))))
write.csv(gene_tab, "tables/SuppTable4_MP_top50_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# over-representation per MP (Hallmark, GO BP); universe = genes variable in at least one unit
enr_file <- file.path(J, "17j_mp_enrichment.csv")
if (!file.exists(enr_file)) {
  universe <- unique(unlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "hvg")))
  msig <- function(...) msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", ...) |> dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
  gsets <- list(Hallmark = msig(collection = "H"), `GO BP` = msig(collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP"))
  enr <- bind_rows(lapply(mps, function(k) bind_rows(lapply(names(gsets), function(src) {
    e <- enricher(genes[[k]], TERM2GENE = gsets[[src]], universe = universe, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, minGSSize = 5, maxGSSize = 1000)
    if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
    as_tibble(e@result) |> transmute(MP = k, source = src, term = ID, GeneRatio, BgRatio, overlap = Count, p = pvalue, padj = p.adjust, genes = geneID)
  }))))
  write.csv(enr, enr_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
enr <- fread(enr_file)
```

```{r scores}
# UCell (maxRank 1500) of the nine MPs on every melanoma cell and healthy melanocyte of the atlas
cell_file <- file.path(S, "17k_cell_scores.qs2")
if (!file.exists(cell_file)) {
  o <- qread(obj_file); md <- o@meta.data
  keep <- rownames(md)[md$majority_celltype %in% c("Melanoma cells", "Melanocytes")]
  cnt <- SeuratObject::LayerData(o, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, keep]; md <- md[keep, ]; rm(o); invisible(gc())
  sc <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(cnt, features = genes, maxRank = 1500, ncores = ncores, chunk.size = 1000)
  colnames(sc) <- sub("_UCell$", "", colnames(sc))
  cols <- c("orig.ident", "Sample", "Patient_nr", "origin", "majority_celltype", "primary_location", "healthy_location",
            "secondary_mutation", "primary_mutation", "Gender", "has_loss_chr3", "has_dupli_chr8")
  cells <- data.frame(cell = rownames(md), md[, cols], sc[rownames(md), ], check.names = FALSE)
  cells$group <- ifelse(cells$majority_celltype == "Melanoma cells", "malignant", "healthy")
  dir.create(S, showWarnings = FALSE); qsave(cells, cell_file)
}
cells <- qread(cell_file)
stopifnot(all(mps %in% names(cells)), all(cells$origin[cells$group == "healthy"] == "non-malignant"))
```

```{r tests}
# unit = patient: library means, then the mean of a patient's libraries within a group; a healthy unit is
# patient x location (one patient has melanocytes from two sites). Monosomy 3 / chr8 gain = >= 50% of tumour cells.
lib <- cells |> group_by(group, Sample, Patient_nr, origin) |>
  summarise(n_cells = n(), chr3_frac = mean(has_loss_chr3 >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE), chr8_frac = mean(has_dupli_chr8 >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
            secondary_mutation = dplyr::first(secondary_mutation), primary_mutation = dplyr::first(primary_mutation), Gender = dplyr::first(Gender),
            primary_location = dplyr::first(primary_location), healthy_location = dplyr::first(healthy_location),
            across(all_of(mps), mean), .groups = "drop")
pat <- lib |> group_by(group, Patient_nr, origin, healthy_location) |>
  summarise(n_cells = sum(n_cells), across(c(chr3_frac, chr8_frac, all_of(mps)), mean),
            across(c(secondary_mutation, primary_mutation, Gender, primary_location), ~ paste(sort(unique(.x)), collapse = "|")), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(chr3 = ifelse(chr3_frac >= 0.5, "monosomy 3", "disomy 3"), chr8 = ifelse(chr8_frac >= 0.5, "chr8 gain", "no chr8 gain"),
         origin3 = factor(dplyr::recode(origin, `non-malignant` = "healthy melanocytes"), levels = c("healthy melanocytes", "primary", "metastasis")))
pat_o <- pat |> group_by(group, Patient_nr, origin3) |> summarise(across(all_of(mps), mean), .groups = "drop")   # one row per patient and group
pum <- dplyr::filter(pat, origin == "primary"); tum <- dplyr::filter(pat, group == "malignant")

two <- function(d, v, gcol, g1, g2, family, cmp) {
  x1 <- d[[v]][d[[gcol]] == g1]; x2 <- d[[v]][d[[gcol]] == g2]
  if (length(x1) < 2 || length(x2) < 2) return(NULL)
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x2, x1))
  tibble(var = v, family = family, comparison = cmp, test = "Wilcoxon", groups = sprintf("%s (n=%d) vs %s (n=%d)", g2, length(x2), g1, length(x1)),
         effect_rb = unname(2 * w$statistic / (length(x1) * length(x2)) - 1), median_diff = median(x2) - median(x1), p = w$p.value)
}
kw <- function(d, v, gcol, lv, family) {
  d <- d[d[[gcol]] %in% lv, ]
  tibble(var = v, family = family, comparison = paste(family, "(omnibus)"), test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
         groups = paste(sprintf("%s (n=%d)", lv, as.integer(table(factor(d[[gcol]], levels = lv)))), collapse = " / "),
         p = kruskal.test(d[[v]], factor(d[[gcol]]))$p.value)
}
three <- function(d, v, gcol, lv, family) bind_rows(kw(d, v, gcol, lv, family),
  two(d, v, gcol, lv[1], lv[2], family, sprintf("%s: %s vs %s", family, lv[2], lv[1])),
  two(d, v, gcol, lv[1], lv[3], family, sprintf("%s: %s vs %s", family, lv[3], lv[1])),
  two(d, v, gcol, lv[2], lv[3], family, sprintf("%s: %s vs %s", family, lv[3], lv[2])))
mut <- c("BAP1", "SF3B1", "EIF1AX"); loc <- c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body")   # ciliochoroidal not tested
run_tests <- function(v) bind_rows(
  three(pat_o, v, "origin3", levels(pat$origin3), "origin"),
  three(dplyr::filter(pum, secondary_mutation %in% mut), v, "secondary_mutation", mut, "secondary mutation, all pUM"),
  three(dplyr::filter(pum, secondary_mutation %in% mut, primary_location == "choroid"), v, "secondary_mutation", mut, "secondary mutation, choroidal pUM"),
  two(pum, v, "chr3", "disomy 3", "monosomy 3", "chr3, pUM", "chr3, pUM: monosomy 3 vs disomy 3"),
  two(pum, v, "chr8", "no chr8 gain", "chr8 gain", "chr8, pUM", "chr8, pUM: gain vs no gain"),
  three(pum, v, "primary_location", loc, "location, pUM"),
  three(dplyr::filter(pat, group == "healthy"), v, "healthy_location", loc, "location, healthy melanocytes"),
  two(dplyr::filter(tum, primary_mutation %in% c("GNAQ", "GNA11")), v, "primary_mutation", "GNAQ", "GNA11", "GNAQ/GNA11, all tumours", "GNAQ/GNA11, all tumours: GNA11 vs GNAQ"),
  two(tum, v, "Gender", "F", "M", "sex, all tumours", "sex, all tumours: M vs F"))
# BH over all tests of one grouping (9 MPs, Kruskal-Wallis omnibus included)
tests <- bind_rows(lapply(mps, run_tests)) |> mutate(MP = var, label = lab[var], .before = 1) |> dplyr::select(-var) |>
  group_by(family) |> mutate(padj_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()
write.csv(tests, "tables/Fig4e-g_SFig7b_MP_metadata_tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

**Purpose**: find recurrent transcriptional programs of the melanocytic lineage de novo and compare them across clinical groups and under tebentafusp.

- **Input**: melanoma cells and healthy melanocytes of the `MelanocyteMelanoma` subset (`majority_celltype`).
- **NMF** (Gavish et al. 2023): `r length(samples)` samples (orig.ident) with at least 100 melanocytic cells, 500 cells drawn per sample. Per sample, the 2,000 most variable genes (ribosomal and mitochondrial genes excluded) are scaled with `percent.mt` regressed, negative values set to 0, and factorised with RcppML at k = 8, 10, 12; a program is its 50 top-weighted genes. `r sum(pinfo$robust)` of `r nrow(pinfo)` programs are robust; greedy clustering gives `r length(genes)` MPs of 50 genes, each in at least 10% of samples.
- **Scores**: UCell (maxRank 1500) of each MP on all `r nfmt(nrow(cells))` melanocytic cells.
- **Unit**: the patient (mean score of its cells, per group). Wilcoxon rank-sum tests (Kruskal-Wallis for three groups), Benjamini-Hochberg over all tests of one grouping (9 MPs); figures show adj. p.
- **Tebentafusp**: tumour cells of three patients with paired liver metastasis biopsies before and on treatment, scored with the same MPs (maxRank 1500). Path to the object: parameter `tebe_object`. Tests within a patient compare cells (descriptive, unadjusted); the treatment test is a paired t-test on the three per-patient medians, BH over the testable MPs.

## Figure 4a

```{r fig4a, out.width = "80%"}
pr <- dplyr::filter(pinfo, robust) |> mutate(MPf = factor(ifelse(is.na(MP), "none", MP), c(mps, "none")))
stopifnot(nrow(pr) == 242)
O2 <- O[pr$program, pr$program]; JJ <- O2 / (2 * NTOP - O2)
ord <- unlist(lapply(levels(pr$MPf), function(m) { p <- pr$program[pr$MPf == m]
  if (length(p) > 2) p[hclust(as.dist(1 - JJ[p, p]), "average")$order] else p }))
JJ <- JJ[ord, ord]; mpo <- pr$MPf[match(ord, pr$program)]
top_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(MP = mpo, Group = pr$group[match(ord, pr$program)],
  col = list(MP = c(MP_COLS, none = "grey85"), Group = c(healthy = "#1B9E77", malignant = "#D95F02")),
  show_legend = c(MP = FALSE, Group = TRUE), annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
  annotation_legend_param = list(Group = list(title = "Sample", title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))))
f <- save_ht(function() draw(Heatmap(JJ, name = "Jaccard", col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.1, 0.5), c("white", "#FDAE61", "#67001F")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE, use_raster = FALSE,
  row_split = mpo, column_split = mpo, row_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"), column_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"),
  row_title_rot = 0, row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13), column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12), column_title_rot = 90,
  left_annotation = rowAnnotation(MP = mpo, col = list(MP = c(MP_COLS, none = "grey85")), show_legend = FALSE, show_annotation_name = FALSE),
  top_annotation = top_ann, heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))),
  column_title = sprintf("%d robust NMF programs ordered by meta-program (Jaccard of the top-50 genes)", nrow(pr)),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"), padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")),
  "Fig4a_program_similarity_heatmap", 14, 13)
knitr::include_graphics(f)
```

## Figure 4b

```{r fig4b, out.width = "33%"}
sc <- as.data.table(cells)
cells_txt <- sprintf("%s melanocytic cells (%s melanoma cells, %s melanocytes)", nfmt(nrow(sc)),
                     nfmt(sc[majority_celltype == "Melanoma cells", .N]), nfmt(sc[majority_celltype == "Melanocytes", .N]))
umm <- merge(fread(umap_file), sc[, c("cell", mps), with = FALSE], by = "cell")
stopifnot("UMAP misses melanocytic cells" = nrow(umm) == nrow(sc))
set.seed(14); umm <- umm[sample(.N)]
thm <- theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10),
        plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.title.position = "plot", axis.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"))
f <- sapply(mps, function(m) {
  lim <- quantile(umm[[m]], c(0.01, 0.99)); if (diff(lim) <= 0) lim <- range(umm[[m]])
  p <- ggplot(umm[order(umm[[m]])], aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = .data[[m]])) + geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2.8, pixels = c(2400, 2400)) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = lim, oob = scales::squish, name = "UCell") +
    labs(title = stringr::str_wrap(lab[[m]], 40), x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2",
         caption = wrap_cap(sprintf("Atlas UMAP, %s. Highest score drawn on top. Colour capped at percentiles 1 and 99 (%.2f to %.2f).",
                                    cells_txt, lim[1], lim[2]), 7.5)) +
    thm + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
  save_gg(p, paste0("Fig4b_umap_", m), 7.5, 7.5)
})
knitr::include_graphics(f)
```

```{r fig4c}
w3 <- readxl::read_excel(params$gavish_3ca_xlsx, sheet = "Malignant")
w3 <- lapply(as.list(w3), function(x) unique(na.omit(x))); names(w3) <- stringr::str_squish(names(w3))
w3_shared <- t(sapply(genes, function(m) sapply(w3, function(x) length(intersect(m, x)))))
w3_frac <- sweep(w3_shared, 2, lengths(w3), "/")
best <- apply(w3_frac, 2, max)
top <- names(best)[best >= 0.1]   # 3CA programs sharing >= 10% of their genes with an MP
top <- top[order(apply(w3_frac[, top, drop = FALSE], 2, which.max), -best[top])]
rownames(w3_frac) <- rownames(w3_shared) <- lab[rownames(w3_shared)]
f <- save_ht(function() draw(
  do.call(Heatmap, c(list(w3_frac[, top], name = "share of\n3CA genes", col = colorRamp2(c(0, max(w3_frac[, top])), c("white", "#B2182B")),
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45,
    column_title = "Overlap with the Weizmann 3CA malignant meta-programs (number = shared genes)",
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) grid.text(w3_shared[i, top[j]], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 13))), hfont)),
```

## Figure 4e-g

```{r fig4efg}
stars_box <- function(q) as.character(cut(q, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
pal <- c("healthy melanocytes" = origin_colors[["non-malignant"]], primary = origin_colors[["primary"]], metastasis = origin_colors[["metastasis"]],
         "disomy 3" = "#4C9BD6", "monosomy 3" = "#C0392B")
box_mp <- function(fam, d0, gcol, lv, ms, title) {
  d <- d0 |> dplyr::select(Patient_nr, grp = all_of(gcol), all_of(ms)) |> tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(ms), names_to = "MP", values_to = "score") |>
    mutate(grp = factor(grp, levels = lv), panel = factor(lab[MP], levels = lab[mps]))
  stopifnot(nrow(d) > 0)
  nlab <- d |> distinct(Patient_nr, grp) |> count(grp)
  levels(d$grp) <- sprintf("%s\n(n = %d)", lv, nlab$n[match(lv, nlab$grp)])
  grp_col <- setNames(pal[lv], levels(d$grp))
  pairs <- dplyr::filter(tests, family == fam, test == "Wilcoxon", MP %in% ms)
  ann <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
    lv2 <- sub(" \\(n=\\d+\\) vs .*", "", pairs$groups[i]); lv1 <- sub(".* vs (.*) \\(n=\\d+\\)$", "\\1", pairs$groups[i])
    tibble(panel = factor(lab[pairs$MP[i]], levels = lab[mps]), x1 = match(lv1, lv), x2 = match(lv2, lv),
           lab = sprintf("%s  adj. p = %.2g", stars_box(pairs$padj_BH[i]), pairs$padj_BH[i]))
  }))
  ymax <- d |> group_by(panel) |> summarise(top = max(score), rng = diff(range(score)), .groups = "drop")
  ann <- ann |> left_join(ymax, by = "panel") |> group_by(panel) |> mutate(y = top + rng * (0.1 + 0.16 * (row_number() - 1)), tip = rng * 0.02) |> ungroup()
  ggplot(d, aes(grp, score)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = grp), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = grp), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_col, guide = "none") + scale_colour_manual(values = grp_col, guide = "none") +
    geom_segment(data = ann, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = ann, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y - tip), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = ann, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y - tip), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.9) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(4, length(ms)), labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 30)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "UCell score (patient mean)", title = title,
         caption = paste(strwrap(sprintf("One point per patient (mean UCell score of its cells); Wilcoxon rank-sum on patient means, two-sided, BH-adjusted within this grouping (%d tests over the 9 MPs%s); *** < 0.001, ** < 0.01, * < 0.05, ns >= 0.05.",
                                         sum(tests$family == fam), if (length(lv) == 3) ", Kruskal-Wallis omnibus included" else ""), 110), collapse = "\n")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot",
                                          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5), strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
}
set.seed(42)
p <- box_mp("origin", pat_o, "origin3", levels(pat$origin3), mps, "MPs by origin")
f1 <- save_gg(p, "Fig4e_box_disease_category", 15.4, 12)
p <- box_mp("chr3, pUM", pum, "chr3", c("disomy 3", "monosomy 3"), c("MP6", "MP8"), "MP6 and MP8 by chr3, pUM")
f2 <- save_gg(p, "Fig4fg_box_pUM_chr3_MP6_MP8", 7.5, 5.2)
knitr::include_graphics(c(f1, f2))
```

```{r tebe}
# tumour cells (CellType "Melanoma") of the baseline (BL) and first on-treatment (FU1) biopsies
te_file <- file.path(TB, "scores_ucell_tebe.csv.gz")
if (!file.exists(te_file)) {
  o <- qread(params$tebe_object)
  o <- subset(o, subset = CellType_Harmonized_Detailed == "Melanoma" & Timepoint %in% c("BL", "FU1"))
  o[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(o[["RNA"]])
  sc_te <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(SeuratObject::LayerData(o, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"), features = genes, name = "", maxRank = 1500, ncores = ncores)
  dir.create(TB, showWarnings = FALSE)
  fwrite(data.table(cell = colnames(o), patient = o$Patient, group = as.character(o$Timepoint), as.data.table(as.matrix(sc_te[colnames(o), mps]))), te_file)
  rm(o); invisible(gc())
}
te <- fread(te_file)
stopifnot(setequal(unique(te$group), c("BL", "FU1")), setequal(unique(te$patient), c("mUM13", "mUM14", "mUM16")))
te[, timepoint := factor(c(BL = "pre", FU1 = "on")[group], c("pre", "on"))]
te[, top_MP := mps[max.col(as.matrix(.SD), ties.method = "first")], .SDcols = mps]
te_n <- te[, .N, by = .(patient, timepoint)]
stars4 <- function(p) as.character(cut(p, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p == 0, "< 1e-300", ifelse(p < 0.001, sprintf("%.0e", p), sprintf("%.3f", p)))
p_is <- function(p) ifelse(p == 0, "p < 1e-300", paste("p =", fmt_p(p)))

# treatment test: paired t-test on the 3 per-patient medians; BH over the MPs whose differences vary
pm <- dcast(melt(te, id.vars = c("patient", "timepoint"), measure.vars = mps, variable.name = "MP")[, .(m = median(value)), by = .(MP, patient, timepoint)],
            MP + patient ~ timepoint, value.var = "m")
pt <- pm[, .(up = sum(on > pre), down = sum(on < pre), p = tryCatch(t.test(on, pre, paired = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)), by = MP]
pt[, padj := p.adjust(p, "BH")]
pt[, line := ifelse(is.na(p), sprintf("%d/3 up; paired t not testable (no spread)", up), sprintf("%d/3 up; paired t (3 patients) adj. p = %s", up, fmt_p(padj)))]
fwrite(pt[, .(MP, label = lab[as.character(MP)], patients_up = up, patients_down = down, p_paired_t = p, padj_BH = padj)], "tables/SFig7d_tebentafusp_paired_t.csv")

# within-patient chi-squared test of the highest-program mix, pre vs on (descriptive)
chi <- te[, { tb <- table(timepoint, top_MP); tb <- tb[, colSums(tb) > 0, drop = FALSE]; cs <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tb))
  .(p = cs$p.value, cramers_v = sqrt(cs$statistic / (sum(tb) * (min(dim(tb)) - 1)))) }, by = patient]
share <- te[, .N, by = .(patient, timepoint, top_MP)][, share := N / sum(N), by = .(patient, timepoint)]
fwrite(dcast(share, patient + top_MP ~ timepoint, value.var = "share", fill = 0)[chi, on = "patient"], "tables/SFig7c_tebentafusp_highest_program.csv")
```
